granularity: Top of book only: the best bid and the best offer, one level each, with the quantity resting at that one price. Plus the last trades (time and sales). No further depth levels are published.
source: ShareData (ProfileData). The page states: Price data source: JSE Ltd.
unitNote: This source quotes JSE prices in rand (R). Elsewhere in the terminal JSE prices are in cents (ZAc), which is one hundredth of a rand. The book view prints the rand figure with the source's own unit beside it, so the two are never mixed.
note: The quantity shown with a bid or an offer is the size resting at that single price as the source publishes it. It is not a sum over hidden levels and no other level is published.
